mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 36 degrees at Verona City Hall. Under this clear first quarter moon, you can catch the International Space Station passing high in the sky starting at 5:39 AM, appearing over Mount Horeb before traveling toward Fitchburg and Madison.

In city news from last Thursday, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired. No students were injured in the incident. Additionally, the city reminds residents that they can use an interactive map on the city website to verify their current zoning district and polling location.

We have plenty happening in the community. The Dane County Farmers Market takes place today, and you can also enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Lake Lou-ee throughout the day. Looking ahead, keep an eye out for yoga at Insight Wellness on October 19 and various trivia nights starting October 20.

On Thursday, October 15, officers responded to a report of dangerous driving and arrested a bus driver for O W I. An investigation is currently underway regarding a potential collision with a traffic sign.
For those with a sweet tooth, today's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so stop by to grab a scoop.
